status: Independent packaged source-reference fixtures; tests require neither .reference nor /tmp.

fixtures.kind: independent derived arithmetic, not source literal or C++ execution

regeneration.scope: Original source-extraction script is staged outside the package; its hash records how the four unchanged source TSVs were extracted.

extraction: Original decimal tokens from literal source initializers and return statements; comments masked without moving line offsets. Python float parses each token to IEEE binary64; f64_hex is its big-endian 16-digit bit pattern. No numerical algorithms or production outputs generated expected values.
independent_validation: All TSV decimal cells round-trip to their recorded f64 bits.
All 181 AAIndex numeric-table literal assertions match extracted table bits.
All seven source alanine hydrophobicity assertions match extracted scale bits.
All twenty independently declared Eisenberg values in the profile class test match the residue table.
All seven hydrophobicity rows have exactly canonical-letter support; 999 remains a sentinel.
All source files and staged fixtures carry SHA-256 hashes.
scalar_tolerances: The scalar table records the last explicit TOLERANCE_ABSOLUTE declaration before each assertion. unresolved_default means no explicit declaration yet; ClassTest.h defaults are unavailable in the pinned first-party snapshot. Relative defaults and macro combination behavior are not inferred. Decimal literals can be rounded references, not exact measured outputs.
scalar_scope: Thirty source literals: three GB default-temperature assertions, fourteen pI/charge assertions (including two zero-residual checks), and thirteen profile/window/moment assertions. Source expressions retain local variable names and source line context. No values from the independent temporary GB arithmetic are included.
semantic_notes: AAIndex indicators are not numeric tables: their unusual literal sets are documented in the analysis brief.
Hydrophobicity scalar sentinels are unsupported values, not usable hydrophobicity scores.
pKa field order follows the source PkaValues struct; U=5.73 applies to all scales.
Source scalar tests do not establish safe nonfinite inputs, PTM-specific property changes, or a complete literature validation.

derived_gb.method: Python stdlib arithmetic only; no C++ or Rust execution. Direct Python follows source operation order with host math exp/log. Decimal 90-digit evaluation uses exact binary64 energy values and R/T values, exact multiplication for RT and ln2, and omits terms exp(z) with z<=-10000.
derived_gb.normal_path: Reference test separately evaluates source-ordered binary64 expressions from the 62 protected lookup values. Decimal comparisons allow floating arithmetic/libm rounding and are not a universal correctly-rounded guarantee.
derived_gb.empty_and_underflow: Empty peptide uses the single-term identity for all finite positive temperatures; R*T==0 uses the energy maximum limit. Both are explicit native differences from source numerical failure/finite cancellation.

comparison_policy.lookup_constants: Exact IEEE binary64 equality with original decimal literals; sentinels must reject.
comparison_policy.pka: Isolate every group through terminal annotations or neutral unknown residue X; compare to independently arranged acid/base concentration fractions at pKa plus or minus0.75, tolerance2e-14.
comparison_policy.source_scalars: GB0.01 absolute; nonzero pI5e-4 absolute (rounded literals and source bisection), zero charge1e-3; hydro1e-8. These are explicit reference-suite tolerances, not a claim to reconstruct missing ClassTest relative defaults.
comparison_policy.derived_gb: Four ULPs from independently rounded 90-digit result; ordinary source-expression checks allow four ULPs.
comparison_policy.moments: Independent trigonometric sum using fixture Eisenberg values, angle160degrees, absolute2e-14.

coverage_notes: All 200 public AAIndex cells, all 140 usable hydrophobicity cells and all 42 sentinels are tested directly.
The 62 private GB constants are used by independent singleton and all400canonicalpair source expressions; no test-only public lookup API is added.
All 59 pKa constants are tested through charge calculations, including source terminal suppression and Bjellqvist override positions.
The 30 original scalar assertion rows remain unchanged and retain original tolerance context.
All expected data derive from pinned source literals or independent arithmetic; no native production result generated a golden.
